metadata.description: Privacy is a human right. Thaura’s policy: AES-256 encryption, EU servers, GDPR by design. We never train on your data. We never sell to third parties.

claims.text: THAURA Home Story Constitution API Download Pricing FAQ Contact Try Thaura Thaura Privacy Policy 1. Preamble Thaura GbR ("we", "us", or "Thaura") commits to protecting your privacy in accordance with: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 2016/679 German Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) Principles of the Thaura Constitution 2. Core Product Data Processing 2.1 Fundamental Principles Strong Encryption Architecture: Conversations encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM; TLS 1.2+ in transit. No Sharing: Chat content is never shared with advertisers, analytics services, or external training providers. No Training with User Data: Your interactions are never used for model improvement. No Surveillance Cooperation: We do not cooperate with government surveillance programs or mass data requests. Locality: All servers are located in the EU, in data centers powered by renewable energy under their operators' supply contracts. 2.2 Collected Data Data Category Purpose Retention Period Account Data (Email) Authentication Until account deletion Project Data (User uploads) Context for your queries According to your settings Metadata (IP, Device type) Security & Compliance 30 days 3. Special Features 3.1 Artifacts Generated content is provided exclusively to you No reuse by Thaura without explicit consent 4. Your Rights (GDPR Compliance) Access: Full disclosure of all stored data Rectification: We correct inaccurate data without undue delay Erasure: We delete your data on request (live data within 30 days, encrypted backups within 90 days) Portability: Request a machine-readable export (JSON, Markdown) of your personal data by emailing info@thaura.ai 5. Third Parties & Subprocessors We only work with partners who: Comply with EU data protection standards Transfer data outside the EU only under approved safeguards (SCCs) Are contractually obligated to deletion Current list (2026): Hetzner (Backend hosting, Nuremberg, Germany) Scaleway (Whisper transcription & embeddings, Paris, France) Verda Cloud Oy (self-hosted AI inference, Helsinki, Finland) Stripe (Payments) Resend (Transactional email, EU, Ireland) Web search is powered by Brave Search, which receives search queries but no account-identifying data. Brave is not a sub-processor. 6. Contact Data Protection Contact: Thaura GbR info@thaura.ai Fortunastr. 23 A, 30451 Hannover, Germany Policy changes are communicated 30 days before taking effect. Thaura AI that answers to you, never to advertisers or investors. Private by design.
